_comment: Reference values for lammps-nvt-rdf. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-nvt-rdf:ci.
_calibration_note: LJ fluid at T*=1.2, rho*=0.8442, fixed seed, single-threaded. 5 oracle runs produced identical values. Tolerance set to physical minimum resolution since observed std=0. Cross-verify: 0-step LAMMPS PE evaluation of final.data is deterministic, tol 1e-4. final_pe_ref pinned (seed fixed, run length fixed -> deterministic; thermo prints 7 digits so tol 1e-3).
